Evidence: 1 subcategories: 1 Success+Failure, 0 No Auditing. Compare with the doc audit table.
Remediation: Compare against the audit table on the CPM task page. If load is too high, CyberArk allows Failure-only auditing.

Remediation: Compare the sizes against the values on the CPM task page.

Title: CPM INF security template imported
Expected: [Local Security Policy] gpedit.msc > Security Settings > Import Policy > CPM INF = Imported; secedit /analyze clean
Remediation: Verify with: secedit /analyze /db %temp%\chk.sdb /cfg <CPM INF> /log %temp%\chk.log
FindText: Imports the INI file containing the hardening settings

Title: CyberArk CPM hardening GPO applied
Expected: [Group Policy] gpresult /scope computer /r > CyberArk CPM hardening GPO = Listed as applied; linked to the CPM OU
Evidence: applied computer GPOs: Default Domain Policy; matched: <none>
Remediation: Link the CyberArk CPM hardening GPO to the CPM OU and run gpupdate /force.

Title: Entra ID joined server with the RDS Session Host role installed (field-reported Entra SSO / logon breakage)
Expected:
[Server roles] Get-WindowsFeature > RDS-RD-Server (Remote Desktop Session Host) = If Entra joined: flag as RISK and test Entra / SSO logon
[Entra ID join state] dsregcmd /status > AzureAdJoined, DomainJoined, AzureAdPrt = Document the join type; Microsoft goal state for Entra logon: AzureAdJoined : YES, AzureAdPrt : YES
Evidence: not Entra ID joined | AzureAdJoined=NO; DomainJoined=YES; AzureAdPrt=NO; RDS-RD-Server installed=True
Remediation: PSM needs the RDS Session Host role, so on an Entra-joined PSM host test Entra/SSO logon after role install and after hardening. Microsoft Learn does not state this break for standalone RDS (AVD documents Entra-joined session hosts WITH this role), so treat as a field-reported risk and validate in your build.

Title: PKU2U online-ID authentication enabled (required for Entra ID RDP sign-in)
Expected:
[Local Security Policy] Computer Configuration > Windows Settings > Security Settings > Local Policies > Security Options > Network security: Allow PKU2U authentication requests to this computer to use online identities = Enabled when Entra ID RDP logon is required
[Registry] HKLM\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Control\Lsa\pku2u > AllowOnlineID [REG_DWORD] = 1 (Enabled)
Remediation: Hardening baselines/INFs commonly disable this Security Option; if Entra ID RDP logon is required, it must be Enabled on server and client (Microsoft Learn).
FindText: Network security: Allow PKU2U authentication requests to this computer to use online identities
